description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Reporting' in the namespace 'Goteo\Library'. The class provides methods for generating various reports and statistics related to a crowdfunding platform, including financial, community, projects, categories, and rewards data. It contains a static array of report configurations with corresponding SQL queries for data retrieval.

classes.name: Reporting
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate various reports and statistical summaries based on predefined SQL queries related to platform data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns an associative array of available report identifiers mapped to their labels.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates a report based on the specified report identifier and optional filters, executing the relevant SQL queries and returning structured report data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with given parameters and formats the result according to specified units and formats.

methods.name: getDataRow
methods.description: Executes a SQL query expected to return multiple rows and concatenates the results into a formatted string.
